verdict.rationale: Fly.io's Sprites marketing describes org-level service connections where the agent never handles a raw token. Access can be granted by Sprite name, by label, or down to a single endpoint (e.g. a Slack bot can post but never touch admin). Credentials rotate once for every Sprite, and a single Sprite can be cut off without affecting the rest. That covers the core of least-privilege, revocable credentials for agents. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how scopes are defined and enforced, evidence of scoped or least-privilege tokens for Fly's own platform API (e.g. Machines API tokens limited to an app), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
